candidates.title: Prepare invoice review rows

demandEvidence.chore: Review supplier invoices and compile billing documentation.

ease.reason: The attached n8n templates document PDF invoice extraction and sheet logging; setup and field accuracy remain unverified.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: an office may value less invoice preparation; this paid role does not establish AI-service demand.

feasibility.reason: A two-week fictional-invoice review table matches documented extraction and logging; accounting rules and live access are unknown.

autonomy.reason: Extraction and logging can repeat in the examples; a person must verify every field and decide any accounting action.

evidence.reason: The notice names invoice review and billing documentation; templates show extraction/logging, not this employer’s rules or AI demand.

candidates.reason: Concrete and reference-supported, but repeats recent invoice extraction/review refusals; mean 5.2 is below threshold 6.
